BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55625  Recommendation to approve minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and Business
  Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, October 17, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55626  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending October 31, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55627  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for October 31, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55628  Recommendation to receive updates regarding the health of the trees along
  Belmont Shore Business District.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55629  Recommendation to receive status updates on Conservation Corps of Long
  Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for October 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
